featured_reviews.name: Rafiya Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Would not recommend purchasing this product at all.

Yes, the cloth quality is decent, but that means absolutely nothing when the product itself fails to serve its purpose properly. The sizing/design clearly seems made only for people under 5 feet tall (I'm 5.5"), yet this was nowhere mentioned on the website before purchase. Important details are conveniently hidden while the brand aggressively advertises on Instagram just to push sales.

What makes this worse is that it’s a prepaid-only website, so the company gets your money upfront and then leaves you stranded when there’s an issue. The moment you raise a genuine concern, the response is basically: “our vendor is fixed,” which translates to — we got your money, now deal with it yourself. No refund, no exchange, no actual solution.

For the premium prices they charge, the greed is very obvious. The focus seems to be more on aggressive marketing and collecting payments than providing transparency, accountability, or proper customer support.

Buy only if you’re willing to risk wasting your money on an overpriced product and a company that disappears the moment you need help.

featured_reviews.name: mohd faisal
featured_reviews.review_text: Ordered the Crimson Qalb Nikah Nama because the product description specifically listed a "Nikah Pen with Customisable Acrylic Pen Topper" as included. The order arrived without the pen. When I contacted the seller, they sent me a new screenshot showing the pen was no longer listed and apparently updated the product page afterward. The pen is still visible in the product images, and I have screenshots of the original description showing it was included when I purchased. Very disappointing experience and poor customer service. I expected either the missing item to be sent or some accountability for the misleading listing.

featured_reviews.name: Sheldon Pinto
featured_reviews.review_text:
Defected products at a low price. Had a terrible experience with this local toy and gift shop.
They sold us a product which was broken. Something that we discovered after we opened the gift. To our surprise, the product (which appeared sealed with tapes) did not event start.
Immediately went back to the store and the store owner said that a gear inside may have moved out of place. (This clearly happened before we were even handed over the product at the store because the box appeared sealed)
The owner said he would open it up and fix it. He did and we returned home with the toy.
Minutes after it started working with the new batteries (which we purchased on our second trip to the store) the toy ceased again.
The next day we went to the store again. Where the sneaky owner hinted at the coworker “that we should not exchange this” in Gujarati. Unfortunately for them my wife understood the language and immediately spoke back in the same.
The shop owner refused to take back the toy this time blaming the bad batteries stating that “these Chinese toys take the battery load for nothing more than an hour”. Indeed that wasn’t the case as it barely worked for 5 minutes. They said that a fresh piece of this is expected to come tomorrow and they will exchange this defected piece of with that. My wife immediately asked the shop owner whether they sold her an old piece, they had no answer.
To our luck we also discovered that the toy was used. It was a piece that was returned to the store and was resold. Utter cheats! Never going back here ever again.
